title: RefinementRequest
description: Body of POST /api/refinements (HEL-411) — a user's natural-language message about an EXISTING dashboard/pipeline, grounded in that target's real current live state (its panels/steps) plus workspace-wide context (HEL-345) and panel-capability menus (HEL-365), and turned by Claude (HEL-390) into a validated PatchSet. Never applies the patch set — applying stays the caller's explicit, separate action via the existing POST /api/patch-sets/apply (HEL-406).

message.description: The user's natural-language refinement request (turn 1), or this turn's follow-up instruction when conversationId is present (turn 2+).

conversationId.description: Omit for a fresh single-shot call. When present, continues that owner-scoped, persisted conversation — the server loads its history and the current working patch set; the client never re-sends either. A conversationId belonging to an authoring conversation (or owned by another user) is rejected as not found, never silently reassigned.
